title: Three Five Oh
style: indie pop, 108 BPM, bright electric piano, clappy drums, melodic male vocal, layered harmonies, hopeful build, modern radio pop, hooky
lyrics:
[Intro]
Three point five oh
Three point five oh
The number that decides if you go or you go home

[Verse 1]
Started at a two point five, sweet summer day
Bought a wooden paddle from a guy at the cafe
Three months later I was three point oh
DUPR app pinging on my phone like whoa

[Pre-Chorus]
Climbing every Tuesday, climbing every Sunday
Calling in sick on a Monday for a Monday
Three point two five, three point three seven
Three point four nine — almost in heaven

[Chorus]
Three five oh, three five oh
The line in the sand where the real ones go
Three five oh, three five oh
Beat a four-oh today and my rating won't show
Three five oh

[Verse 2]
Lost to a sandbagger calling himself three flat
Beat him in two but my points went splat
Algorithm cold, algorithm slow
Tell me when I'm climbing, tell me where to go

[Pre-Chorus]
Climbing every Tuesday, climbing every Sunday
Sleeping with my paddle, dreaming about Monday
Three point four eight, three point four nine
One more tournament and the number is mine

[Chorus]
Three five oh, three five oh
The line in the sand where the real ones go
Three five oh, three five oh
Beat a four-oh today and my rating won't show
Three five oh

[Bridge]
The number doesn't love you back
But you can love the climb anyway

[Outro]
Three point five oh
Three point five oh
